source_admission: The study's quantities come from committed project products, each named below with what is read from it. The outside sources are Earth's evidence for the parts of a carrier; each was checked on 22 November 2026 by a search summary only, and none was read in full. Values the README marks as recalled were not looked up, and those it marks as design guesses rest on no source. The entries whose use begins "Cement sizing" were gathered by a delegated agent for cement.py on the same day: Project values were read in the ecology worktree and on the research drive. Outside sources were found by generic web searches on 22 November 2026; most were read only as the search tool's summary of result pages, which can garble units and attributions, and two were read in part through a page-fetch tool that returns an extraction, not the page. No outside paper was read in full by eye. Identifiers are given only where a search result or a fetched page showed them; bibliographic details beyond that are recalled and marked so.
